turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Yes! First, watch me do one.
I sing in the morning. She sings in the morning.
The person is "she", so I add -s: "sings".
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He cooks on Mondays. Wrong: He cook on Mondays.

Now you try. Write only the verb:
My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
